scientific_integrity: Self-contained proof and finite exact-rational checker; prior all-order sufficient bound, m=2 sharp case, and convolution theorem are credited. No external review or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact sign frontier is specific to the power pullback polynomial, m>=2 and p>0. It does not establish new radical orbits, orbital stability, or all spring families. Historical priority provisional; unlocated separately cited specialized preprint is noted.
title: Sharp positive-coefficient frontier for radical power-pullback springs
